note.es: Domingo, mercado cerrado: builtAt se reconstruyo hace 123 min (el cron de Netlify sigue vivo) aunque las fuentes por simbolo y el webhook siguen congeladas desde el cierre del viernes ~21:01Z (~2027 min), justo el patron esperado de finde, no una falla nueva -- se resuelve solo con la reapertura del domingo ~22:00Z. Warn real: heartbeat sigue sin registrar el pre-asia del viernes (recurrencia del caso 2026-09-18, revisar scheduler) y el journal sigue sin actualizarse hace ~150h con huecos desde el 2026-09-21.
note.en: Sunday, market closed: builtAt was rebuilt 123 min ago (the Netlify cron is still alive) even though the per-symbol sources and webhook remain frozen since Friday's close ~21:01Z (~2027 min), exactly the expected weekend pattern, not a new failure -- it resolves on its own at Sunday's reopen ~22:00Z. Real warn items: heartbeat still shows no Friday pre-asia run (a recurrence of the 2026-09-18 case, check the scheduler) and the journal hasn't updated in ~150h with gaps since 2026-09-21.
